context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress Packets with Telemetry Samples from edge devices, bike computers, wearables; device-initiated, immediate, under backpressure.
context_map.boundary_protection: Validation context translates heterogeneous device payloads into Telemetry Samples and tags VALIDATION_FAILED; device-specific formats never leak downstream.

context_map.direction: Telemetry Ingestion & Validation -> Telemetry Stream Processing & History
context_map.exchanged_information: Events TelemetrySampleValidated and TelemetrySampleValidationFailed carrying Telemetry Sample with validation status and t_device; published by Validation, consumed by History.
context_map.boundary_protection: Only the two named events cross; Sensor Metric Boundary definitions and intake/backpressure internals stay private; History never re-validates and never drops failed samples.

context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetrySampleBackfilled, TelemetryRevisionAppended, TelemetryWindowBuffered to downstream streaming analytics (PulseStream Engine).
context_map.boundary_protection: Versioned event contract with backpressure-aware broadcast; raw history storage and reorder window internals are not exposed.

cross_boundary_flows.notes: Retry with idempotent consumption. AMBIGUITY/FLAG: delivery posture and dedup identity (device, metric, t_device) unspecified; assumed owned by History pending discovery answer.
Samples delayed up to 60s reordered by t_device; later packets assumed Event Revision (unspecified). No invariant has 0 or 2 owners. No coupling cycles.
Backpressure-aware; consumers are outside slice, so consumes unmatched on their side.
